long_biography.plain_text:
Philip Zepter turned product demonstration into the operating engine of his company. Instead of depending only on conventional retailers, Zepter International built its own international network of advisers and high-end showrooms. It paired distribution with manufacturing sites in Germany, Italy and Switzerland, retaining control over products ranging from cookware to health and beauty equipment.

In 1994, Philip and Madlena Zepter created a joint foundation supporting scholarships, humanitarian work and young talent. Its cultural programme funded scientific and technical projects alongside the Madlenianum Opera House and Artzept design competition. Artzept gives emerging artists and designers prizes and exhibition opportunities.
